name: How should I prepare my garage before drywall installation starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my garage before drywall installation starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the drywall crew arrives, clear all vehicles, storage bins, tools, and wall-mounted shelving out of the garage. Crews require a minimum of 3 to 4 feet of open clearance along every wall and open access across the floor to move large 8-to-12-foot drywall sheets safely. Check with your contractor regarding any electrical outlet relocations, overhead lighting upgrades, or framing additions for heavy tool racks. Taking care of wiring adjustments beforehand prevents having to cut into freshly taped and finished drywall later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty the garage completely of vehicles, tools, and shelving, and complete any electrical or framing changes before the crew arrives with drywall panels.
